title: {{dana}} maps groups to tools
goal: {{dana}} decides which groups may use which MCP tools at {{vocab.org}}.
obstacle: Three kinds of tool, four groups, and one call that must wait for a human.
control: Allow, hold or deny per group and tool, answered by the same Cedar policies that guard live calls.
say: One table shows what each group can do, and it is computed from the real policies.

steps.title: Open the table
steps.tell: The Who can call what table on the AI Policies tab asks the policy engine one question per cell: a group, a tool and a typical call.
steps.say: Not a diagram of intent. The live answer for every cell.
steps.why: The table cannot drift from the policies because it is made from them.

steps.title: Analysts
steps.tell: Analysts: search and tickets allow, pay_invoice and book_fare deny.
steps.say: This is {{mary}}'s row, the same as S04 from the admin's side.
steps.why: Anything no permit covers is denied.

steps.title: Travel agents and the one that waits
steps.tell: Travel agents: book_fare allow. Tick Dot acts, fare 2,400: the same cell becomes hold, waiting for {{vocab.approverRole}}. Then untick it: while it is ticked every call is unattended, so the other groups' allows turn to deny too.
steps.say: Same group, same tool. Who is acting and how much decide whether it waits.
steps.why: The hold is the middle answer between yes and no.

steps.title: Finance
steps.tell: Finance with the payments:write scope: pay_invoice allow, and nothing else.
steps.say: Payments needs the group and the scope.
steps.why: Removing the scope in Test a request turns that result to deny. The table always asks finance with the scope, so its cell stays allow.

blocked.tell: In Test a request untick payments:write for the finance user. pay_invoice is denied.
blocked.say: A group alone is not enough for Payments.

steps.title: Admins
steps.tell: Admins: deny in every cell. No shipped policy lets the admins group call tools. Admins edit policies, and that is a different permission.
steps.say: Admin is not a master key.
steps.why: The table says so plainly, so nobody assumes otherwise.

steps.title: Change a policy, watch the table
steps.tell: As {{dana}}, edit a policy and press Save as Active (a Candidate is only shadow-tested, so the table does not change). The table recomputes. Press Reset demo afterwards.
steps.say: Edit a rule and see the effect across all groups.
steps.why: A change that surprises someone shows up here first.

proof.happy: The table with one decision per cell. With Dot acts ticked, travel-agents book_fare is the one hold.
proof.blocked: The table's deny cells, each with its deciding rule printed under the decision.
